text:
maya: FYI IAD dense-v2 reporting pod network failures starting 2026-04-02T02:22Z. ~35% of the dense pool returning PodNetwork errors, heavy 5xx for hosted text-gen us-east. Opening thread for runbook decisions.

sanjay: oncall here. thanks maya — investigating. Is the ask to shift traffic now or try in-region mitigation first?

maya: try in-region fixes for 10m; if not stable, shift non-SLA traffic. Prefer pre-warming ATL warm-pool, fall back to ORD if ATL capacity constrained.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260402-iad-densev2-net created by maya

deploy-bot: healthcheck-scan started job/scan-331 status=running

carmen: quick triage: calico/node logs show `vxlan: remote vtep unreachable` and kubelet times out on DeletePodNetwork calls. Drain operations hang due to CNI deletion failures.

liam: note for playbook: add calico-specific preflight. If CNI DeletePodNetwork error rate > 15% for 10m: 1) run `calicoctl node status` on seed nodes; 2) restart calico-daemonset with 10% concurrency; 3) if still degraded after 8m -> prewarm warm-pool in target region and initiate staged traffic shift.

maya: agreed. running `kubectl get nodes -l pool=dense-v2 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status}'` shows many NotReady. Kubelet logs include `error=netlink: no route to host`.

sanjay: attempted `kubectl rollout restart ds/calico-node` on a subset, but some nodes immediately rejoined as NotReady. Looks like underlying hypervisor host network dropped VXLAN routes.

carmen: action: I'll add a new section to the failover playbook: "CNI mesh degradation" with exact thresholds and commands. Also adding a forced-evict fallback if DeletePodNetwork blocks cordon/drain for >15m.

liam: cost note: cross-region reroute will increase egress spend. Add an automated estimate step: `infra-cost-cli estimate --from=iad --to=atl --percent=...` and require oncall acknowledgement if projected > $2.5k/day. Above $3.5k/day, require director approval as per approval matrix.

maya: doing a small canary to ATL now (5%->20%->50%) for non-SLA routes; monitoring latency and failure rate.

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job started id=job-9912 target=atl canary=5% status=running

liam: suggestion: include a prewarm step in the playbook: `infra-warmpool create --region=atl --pool=dense-v2 --size=8 --wait`. Prewarm avoids cold-start latencies and prevents client errors on immediate shift.

carmen: will add prewarm CLI examples. Also adding a rollback criteria: if p90 latency in target region increases >200ms or error rate doubles within 10m, revert 50% of shifted traffic in 10m and notify SRE lead.

sanjay: autoscaler note: current cluster-autoscaler blocks on DeletePodNetwork responses; need a preflight check: if CNI error-rate high, mark node Unschedulable and use force-evict with 30s grace rather than waiting for DeletePodNetwork, to avoid cascading pod pileup. I'll file a ticket.

maya: good. also add a monthly chaos test to simulate CNI VXLAN loss so autoscaler & runbook are validated. Put in eng-infra quarterly run schedule.

carmen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 "incidents: add CNI mesh degradation section + cost/approval steps". Changes include detection thresholds, cost-estimate step, prewarm examples, canary percentages, and forced-evict fallback.

liam: i'll add Grafana tiles: per-region %traffic-redirected, projected-cross-region-ecost, and an alert `CrossRegionEstimate > $2500/day`. Also add finance webhook to #finance-ops for big reroutes.

finance-bot: noted — adding webhook subscription request to #finance-ops after liam's dashboard is live.

sanjay: immediate incident update: canary to ATL reduced 5xx by ~65% within 12m. Some residual errors tied to evicted pods restarting into same host; we're cordoning affected hypervisors.

maya: final action items from thread:
- carmen: merge playbook PR and publish docs (ETA EOD)
- liam: Grafana panels + finance alert (ETA 48h)
- sanjay: autoscaler preflight + force-evict implementation & test (ETA 72h)
- maya: schedule CNI simulation test in infra runbook (ETA next sprint)

carmen: adding a checklist entry to confirm warm-pool prewarm and cost estimate acknowledged before any manual >15% cross-region shift.

maya: closing oncall for now; monitoring for 1h. will write a short RCA in incident tracker and link this thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
